import pandas as pd
import re

file_path = '/data/field_visit_log.xlsx'
df = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Field Visit Log', header=4)

# Ensure correct dtypes
# Deduplicate Visit ID keeping first occurrence
df = df.drop_duplicates(subset='Visit ID', keep='first')

# Normalise village name
def normalize_village(v):
    if pd.isna(v):
        return ''
    s = str(v)
    s = s.strip()
    s = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', s)
    return s.lower()

df['village_norm'] = df['Village'].apply(normalize_village)

# Ensure numeric columns
for col in ['Women Reached', 'Men Reached', 'Children Reached']:
    df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce').fillna(0)

df['people_reached'] = df['Women Reached'] + df['Men Reached'] + df['Children Reached']

# Aggregate
agg = df.groupby('village_norm')['people_reached'].sum().reset_index()
agg = agg.sort_values('people_reached', ascending=False)

print(agg.head(20))

# Title case for display
def title_case_name(s):
    return ' '.join(word.capitalize() for word in s.split())

agg['village_title'] = agg['village_norm'].apply(title_case_name)
print(agg.head(10)[['village_title','people_reached']])
